district_about.budva-center: Budva is the largest resort town on the coast and the heart of the Budva Riviera, with shops, schools, medical facilities and public services open all year round.
district_about.budva-rozino: Rozino is a residential district of Budva close to the town centre.
district_about.budva-waterfront: The seafront part of Budva, by the town promenade.
district_about.budva-ivanica: Ivanica is a residential district of Budva.
district_about.budva-veligrad: Veligrad is a residential district of Budva.
district_about.becici: Bečići is a resort village east of Budva with one of the longest beaches on the Budva Riviera.
district_about.rafailovici: Rafailovići is a seaside village next to Bečići on the Budva Riviera.
district_about.przno: Pržno is a small seaside village between Budva and Sveti Stefan.
district_about.sveti-stefan: Sveti Stefan is a coastal village south-east of Budva, facing the famous island hotel.
district_about.lapcici: Lapčići is a village on the hills above the Budva Riviera.
district_about.tudorovici: Tudorovići is a hillside village above the coast near Pržno.
district_about.lastva-grbaljska: Lastva Grbaljska is a village in the Grbalj valley between Budva and Tivat, a short drive from the coast.
district_about.petrovac: Petrovac is a small resort town on the coast south of Budva.
district_about.buljarica: Buljarica is a bay with a long beach south of Petrovac.
district_about.tivat: Tivat is a town on the Bay of Kotor with an international airport and a yacht marina.
district_about.kotor: Kotor is a historic town at the far end of the Bay of Kotor; its old town is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
district_about.herceg-novi: Herceg Novi is a town at the entrance to the Bay of Kotor.
district_about.bar: Bar is a port town on Montenegro’s southern coast.
district_about.dobra-voda: Dobra Voda is a seaside village on the southern coast, near Bar.
district_about.ulcinj: Ulcinj is the southernmost town on the Montenegrin coast.
district_about.rijeka-crnojevica: Rijeka Crnojevića is a historic village on the river of the same name near Lake Skadar, within the national park.
district_about.cetinje: Cetinje is the historic royal capital of Montenegro, in the country’s mountainous interior.
district_about.podgorica: Podgorica is the capital and largest city of Montenegro.
